Don’t trust a PR.

AegisPR converts code-review claims into controlled experiments. It generates adversarial tests, runs the same test against both commits, and reports only what the evidence supports.

The verification chain

CONTEXT ENGINE

Repository structure before speculation.

AegisPR discovers the stack, changed files, commands, and dependency neighborhood. The Dell NVIDIA GPU ranks relevant context with deterministic CUDA vector scoring.

$ aegis analyze owner/repo#42
✓ 7 changed files indexed
✓ impact neighborhood ranked on cuda
→ sending bounded context to Nemotron

Two compute planes

Each model does the work it is built for.

Nebius serves large-model reasoning. The Dell RTX GPU accelerates context ranking. Docker isolates untrusted repository execution.
